BrochureContent.Content: CME are delighted to bring to the market this 'Nearly New' energy efficient 'A' rated home, located in this modern development by Cannon Kirk. No. 6 offers versatile and well laid out accommodation and is presented in very good condition throughout with tasteful and neutral decor and is ready to move into. No.6 provides two parking spaces to the front and a sunny West facing rear garden, ideal for Al Fresco dining and family gatherings. The Meadows is a well maintained development on a quiet cul-de-sac and provides landscaped green spaces & play areas ideal for families. The village of Kill hosts the renowned Dew Drop gastropub, school, large convenience store, chemist, coffee shops and sporting facilities and is ideally located just off the M7 making commuting an option and is also accessible to the train station at Sallins and only a short drive to the larger town of Naas. Viewing strictly by appointment with sole agents CME 045-897711.
